rulings.restated: Choose — [helper "Basis reported to IRS" = true → helper "Basis shown on broker report"] [helper "Basis reported to IRS" = false → helper "Correct adjusted basis from records (for inherited property shown on a Schedule A (Form 8971) as increasing the estate tax, starting from no more than its final estate tax value)"]
rulings.model: The IRS says "Box A or Box G" and "Box D or Box J" cover transactions with an amount shown for cost or other basis reported to the IRS; the program's "Basis reported to IRS" helper is only boxes A or D, so for boxes G/J it would enter the correct adjusted basis instead of the reported basis.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; same as the refresh-round ruling: boxes G to L are refused at the transaction by sales.digital at sales.one, so the correct-basis branch is never used for them. Project stands.

rulings.restated: Choose — [helper "Basis reported to IRS" = true → helper "Basis shown on broker report"] [helper "Basis reported to IRS" = false → helper "Correct adjusted basis from records (for inherited property shown on a Schedule A (Form 8971) as increasing the estate tax, starting from no more than its final estate tax value)"]
rulings.model: The helper treats only boxes A and D as basis-reported, but the form note says for box A or box G with incorrect reported basis, enter the basis as reported in column (e), and the instructions likewise say box D or box J; G/J would wrongly use the correct-basis branch.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; f8949 p. 1, box G; i8949 p. 8, code B. The model is right that boxes G and J take the reported basis, but boxes G to L are refused at the transaction by sales.digital at sales.one (checked this round: sales.refuse.digital.G refuses Form 1040 lines 7a and 16 on sales[a].digital), so the correct-basis branch is never used for them. Same point as the earlier rounds. Project stands on the English.

rulings.restated: Choose — [helper "Basis reported to IRS" = true → helper "Basis shown on broker report"] [helper "Basis reported to IRS" = false → helper "Correct adjusted basis from records"]
rulings.model: The restatement's 'Basis reported to IRS' gate is true only for classifications A or D, but the IRS form also treats boxes G and J as 'reported on Form(s) 1099-DA showing basis was reported to the IRS'; for those rows column (e) must use the reported basis, not the records basis.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; f8949 p. 1, box G: "Short-term transactions reported on Form(s) 1099-DA showing basis was reported to the IRS"; i8949 p. 8, code B. Boxes G to L are refused at the transaction: sales.one refuses when sales.digital ("Form 8949 digital asset boxes G–L"), and the refusal reaches every Schedule D total and Form 1040 line 7a (checked: sales.refuse.digital.G gives sd.line15, f1040.line7a and f1040.line16 refused on sales.digital, while the row's own column (e) shows $2,000.00 and reaches no Schedule D line). Within boxes A to F the gate reads as the instructions do. The gate must widen to G and J if digital assets come into scope. Project stands on the English.

rulings.restated: Add helper "Basis correction in column (g)" and helper "Wash-sale adjustment in column (g)".
rulings.model: Because the basis-reported gate omits box G and box J, no code B adjustment is made for those reported-basis transactions; the IRS code B instruction says for box A or box G (and box D or box J) enter the reported basis in column (e) and 'Correct the error by entering an adjustment in column (g).'
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; i8949 p. 8, code B: "Correct the error by entering an adjustment in column (g)". As column (e): boxes G and J are refused with every digital-asset box, so the A/D condition is the whole supported case. Same point as the earlier rounds. Project stands on the English.

rulings.restated: Add helper "Basis correction in column (g)" and helper "Wash-sale adjustment in column (g)".
rulings.model: IRS column (g) says 'Enter in this column any necessary adjustments to gain (or loss)' and, for multiple codes, 'enter the net adjustment in column (g)'; the restatement only adds B basis correction and W wash-sale adjustment, omitting other required adjustment codes.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; i8949 p. 8, code B; i8949 pp. 7–11, columns (f) and (g). Boxes G and J are refused with every digital-asset box (see column (e)), so the A/D condition of the basis correction is the whole supported case. Codes other than B and W are refused: sales.one refuses when sales.bad_code ("Only applicable B and W adjustments are supported"), and the refusal reaches the Schedule D totals and Form 1040 (checked: sales.refuse.code gives sd.line15, f1040.line7a and f1040.line16 refused on sales.bad_code while the row's own column (g) shows $0.00). Project stands on the English.

rulings.restated: Add helper "Basis correction in column (g)" and helper "Wash-sale adjustment in column (g)".
rulings.model: The IRS says "Enter in this column any necessary adjustments to gain (or loss)" and, for multiple codes, "enter the net adjustment in column (g)"; the restatement only adds code B and code W adjustments, omitting other necessary adjustments such as codes E, H, or L.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; the model names other codes (E, H, L); codes other than B and W are refused at sales.one on sales.bad_code ("Only applicable B and W adjustments are supported"), and boxes G and J with every digital-asset box, so on a completed return column (g) is the code B correction plus the code W adjustment. Project stands.
